about_the_game:
This game includes duels with 20 enemy chieftains. The game mainly consists of two gameplay modes: chief duel and map exploration.

Chief Duel gameplay:

1. The operation is simple and crude, all you need is your hands. There’s no crazy list of moves, even if you don’t know them all. You can still play by left-clicking to attack and right-clicking to defend and shift to dodge.
2. The enemies are extremely powerful and shocking. But as you gradually learn and master the game mechanics, become familiar with the enemy's routines and AI, and use skills and items rationally, you will become extremely powerful and shocking too.

Map adventure gameplay:

1. Before dueling with the chief, you will have the opportunity to collect food on the map. Food can temporarily increase your ability during a duel.
2. There are 4 pieces of food in each map. It is very difficult to collect them all. If you are a brave and reckless person, you can also choose to ignore the food and go straight to it!

This is an individual game developed with limited resources. There is no complicated world view setting, no red tape plot, and no annoying level design, just go for the boss and fight!
Fight! Cool! Die! Fight Again! Cut off the enemy's head!

name: 只猩：酋长争霸
short_description: This is a 3d action game. Find your enemies in difficult mazes, duel with shocking bosses, decapitate them in a flash of swords, and earn your honor! I came, I saw, I conquered! Chief, it’s time to pick up your sword and start your journey!
